digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git repository fetch
propositions: CI workflows must apply --filter=blob:none to all tickets-branch fetch operations to reduce transfer size from ~1.0–6.7 GiB to ~20–70 MiB

Named-remote filter inheritance and explicit --filter=blob:none on direct URL fetches must be verified via Git protocol packet traces confirming filter capability advertisement and blob:none negotiation

Production guards must parse git count-objects pack size after checkout/materialization and reject oversized packs exceeding REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400 or REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072

Blobless partial-clone checkouts must preserve complete commit graph for merge-base/era scoping and must not introduce additional object fetches during identity verification (count-objects must remain unchanged)

Real-Git fixture with git daemon, temporary global config, and packet tracing must validate filter negotiation and missing-blob behavior across named-origin, depth-1 direct URL, and full-history direct URL fetch paths
